name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-talking-flower-dropdown-countdown-lift-and-gamboo
title: Super Mario World Styled Talking Flower, Dropdown Countdown Lift and Gamboo
description:
Some Super Mario Bros. Wonder sprites ported into SMW using mostly vanilla paletes.
Credits to DeltomX3 from the Spriters Resource website for drawing the sprites in .png format

This pack includes:
-Talking Flower (Replaces the Info Box);
- Gamboo (Replaces Galoomba / Goomba);
- Dropdown Countdown Lift (Replaces Carrot Lifts);
